title: [Snappi][Bug] Typo on variable.override.yml file causes key-error in get_snappi_ports_for_rdma function
author: amitpawar12
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

The file tests/snappi_tests/variables.override.yml has "hostname" as "host_name" causing key error in function get_snappi_ports_for_rdma defined in snappi_fixtures.py.

```
    for port in snappi_port_list:
        for var_rx_port in var_rx_ports:
            if port['peer_port'] == var_rx_port['port_name'] and port['peer_device'] == var_rx_port['hostname']:
                rx_snappi_ports.append(port)
```

The var_rx_port is checking for key hostname whereas "host_name" is defined in variables.override.yml.

```
vms-snappi-sonic-multidut:
  multidut_port_info:
    - multi-dut-single-asic:
        rx_ports:
          - hostname: sonic-s6100-dut1
            port_name: Ethernet72
          - host_name: sonic-s6100-dut2
            port_name: Ethernet76
```


### Steps to Reproduce

Modify the definitions and run test with static ports. 

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual behavior - key-error while trying to read var_rx_port['hostname'].

```
INFO     root:__init__.py:69 -------------------- fixture tgen_port_info setup starts --------------------
ERROR    root:__init__.py:73 
KeyError('hostname')
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/data/tests/common/plugins/log_section_start/__init__.py", line 71, in _fixture_func_decorator
    return fixture_func(*args, **kargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/data/tests/common/snappi_tests/snappi_fixtures.py", line 1869, in tgen_port_info
    snappi_ports = get_snappi_ports_for_rdma(
                   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/data/tests/common/snappi_tests/snappi_fixtures.py", line 1435, in get_snappi_ports_for_rdma
    if port['peer_port'] == var_rx_port['port_name'] and port['peer_device'] == var_rx_port['hostname']:
                                                                                ~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^
KeyError: 'hostname'
INFO     root:__init__.py:76 -------------------- fixture tgen_port_info setup ends --------------------
```

There should be no key error.
